facts: The native Timed Jackpot guarantees payment before a displayed date/time.
Its win probability rises as the guaranteed deadline approaches and reaches 100% at the last guaranteed-payment time.
A jackpot can be triggered and won in a single spin by a single player.
The chance of a jackpot increases in correlation with stake size.
Only a capped part of each stake is eligible for the timed tiers; stake above the cap is routed to the progressive tier.
Connectivity can delay displayed jackpot values, so displayed state cannot be assumed identical to effective state.
